about.title: About Loan Refinance Calculator - Refinancing Savings Analysis Tool
about.description: The Loan Refinance Calculator is a comprehensive refinancing analysis tool designed to help you determine if refinancing your existing loan will save money and improve your financial situation. This calculator compares your current loan terms with new refinancing options, calculating monthly payment changes, interest savings, and break-even points. Whether you're considering refinancing a personal loan, auto loan, or other debt, this tool provides detailed analysis of refinancing benefits.

faq.q: When should I consider refinancing my loan?
faq.a: Consider refinancing when interest rates have dropped significantly (0.5-1% or more), your credit score has improved, you want to change loan terms, or you need to access equity. The key is ensuring savings exceed refinancing costs.

faq.q: What costs are involved in loan refinancing?
faq.a: Refinancing costs may include application fees, origination fees, appraisal costs, title insurance, and prepayment penalties on your existing loan. These typically range from 1-3% of the loan amount.

faq.q: How do I calculate if refinancing is worth it?
faq.a: Compare total costs: (monthly savings × months you'll keep the loan) minus refinancing costs. If the result is positive and you'll stay past the break-even point, refinancing likely makes sense.

faq.q: Can I refinance any type of loan?
faq.a: Most loans can be refinanced including mortgages, auto loans, personal loans, and student loans. However, availability and terms vary by loan type and lender. Some loans may have prepayment penalties that affect refinancing benefits.
